description:
Cast Wispweaver Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Toph.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Wispweaver Angel as it's a land due to Ashaya.
Since zero mana was spent to cast Toph, Wispweaver Angel becomes a 0/0 creature and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Toph triggers, returning Wispweaver Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
